name: Eye of Ugin
description: The Eye of Ugin is a hidden cavern beneath the Teeth of Akoum on Zendikar, the focal point of the hedron prison that bound the Eldrazi.

description_citations.text: "Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

summary.text: The Eye of Ugin is a hidden cavern beneath the Teeth of Akoum on Zendikar, the focal point of the hedron prison that bound the Eldrazi.

citations.text: "Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

bio.text: Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri imprisoned the Eldrazi on Zendikar with a hedron network centered on the Eye, and sealed it with a lock that needs three planeswalker sparks and Ugin's breath.

citations.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Eye of Ugin", section "First breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ugin", section "The Three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Vampires built a shrine near the Eye that destabilized the prison, so Nahiri awoke and restored it alone.

citations.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "First breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Bolas sent Sarkhan to guard the Eye, where Jace and Chandra fought him, and Chandra's colorless fire loosened the Eldrazi's bonds.

citations.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Second breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Release of the Eldrazi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Sorin returned with Nissa to reseal the prison, but Nissa shattered the central hedron and released the Eldrazi titans.

citations.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Release of the Eldrazi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Jace later descended into the ruined Eye and met Ugin, who revealed he had built it and asked Jace to find Sorin.

citations.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.
"Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.
"Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

bio.text: Nahiri later found the Eye collapsed and the three titans gone.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

status.text: The Eye of Ugin is collapsed and empty, as the last story that mentions it shows the titans have escaped.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa breaks the central hedron in the Eye of Ugin, freeing the Eldrazi Titans.
timeline.quote: Nissa breaking the central hedron in the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Chandra defeat Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: With it, the pair defeated Sarkhan, knocking the entire group unconscious.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, a lithomancer and Sorin Markov trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar with a lock-spell at the Eye of Ugin and leave.
timeline.quote: the planeswalkers trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar

citation.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar, guessing she is chasing the Eye of Ugin from a stolen scroll's map.
timeline.quote: After a short time, he regretted the way things had ended and decided to find her.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: Chandra gains the ability to wield colorless fire, which lets her unlock the Eye of Ugin in the Awakenings comic.
timeline.quote: Chandra gains the ability to wield colorless fire in order to unlock the Eye of Ugin in the Awakenings comic

citation.text: "Rise of the Inbox". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The released Brood Lineage find Anowon near the Eye and enslave him for three months.
timeline.quote: they found Anowon near the Eye and enslaved him like all other vampires they encounter.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Enslavement and Return to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi manifest on Zendikar, are confined and sink into dormancy; the planeswalkers disband, Nahiri staying to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The meeting of Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace in the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds and they rise to feed again.
timeline.quote: they rose to feed on the life of Zendikar again.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers combine their magic at the Eye of Ugin to activate the hedron network, sealing the Titans in stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin ally against the Eldrazi but cannot defeat them, and instead imprison them on Zendikar with a hedron network centered on the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: Instead of killing the Eldrazi, they caused the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers seal the Eye with a lock that needs three planeswalker sparks and Ugin's breath, then disband.
timeline.quote: Their mission complete, the planeswalkers disbanded.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "First breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vampires build a shrine near the Eye, destabilizing the prison; Nahiri awakens, calls for help in vain, restores the prison alone, then leaves to find Sorin.
timeline.quote: She succeeded on her own, and restored the prison.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "First breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Sarkhan to guard the Eye; Chandra and Jace, guided by Anowon, confront him there, and Chandra's invisible flame spell loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
timeline.quote: thus unknowingly loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Second breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns, frees Anowon and goes with Nissa to the Eye, where Nissa shatters the main hedron, releasing the Eldrazi; Sorin leaves the plane.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers fight, converge at the Eye of Ugin and activate the hedron network, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Eye of Ugin, Nissa shatters the main hedron and releases the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Sarkhan deal with the aftermath of releasing the Eye of Ugin seal.
timeline.quote: Enter the Eldrazi is a webcomic about Jace and Sarkhan as they deal with the aftermath of releasing the Eye of Ugin seal.

citation.text: "Rise of the Eldrazi", section "Webcomic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan wanders the Eye of Ugin on Bolas's orders and saves Chandra from Anowon.
timeline.quote: he became lucid in time to save Chandra Nalaar from an attack by the vampire ruin sage named Anowon

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan attacks Chandra as a dragon; Jace and Chandra defeat him with Ugin's invisible fire, unlocking the Eldrazi confinement.
timeline.quote: But this action unwittingly opened the last lock of the Eldrazi confinement spell.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri lure and imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar for 6,000 years.
timeline.quote: The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi caused the three Titans to become trapped in the plane for 6,000 years.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "The Three". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers activate the hedron network at the Eye of Ugin, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek manifest, are confined by the hedrons and sink into dormancy; Sorin and Ugin leave while Nahiri stays to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The meeting of Vol, Nalaar and Beleren at the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
timeline.quote: The meeting of Vol, Nalaar, and Beleren in the Eye of Ugin chamber loosened the bonds that kept the Eldrazi in torpor

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa destroys the keylock hedron, completing the Release of the Eldrazi despite Sorin's intent to reseal the prison.
timeline.quote: Nissa instead acted by destroying the keylock hedron, and the Release of the Eldrazi was a fact.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Eye of Ugin, Nissa shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment, releasing the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: Nissa, believing the titans should be freed to return to the stars, shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The titans remain on Zendikar and Sorin abandons the plane and Nissa.
timeline.quote: Horrified, Sorin abandons the plane and the "foolish elf" who refused to listen

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra steals a scroll from the Sanctum of Stars on Kephalai; Jace is hired to recover it, leading both Planeswalkers to the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: the scroll Jace was hired to recover that later led both Planeswalkers fatefully to the Eye of Ugin on Zendikar

citation.work: Eleventeen M12 Art Tidbits. Also, Plants!
citation.text: "Eleventeen M12 Art Tidbits. Also, Plants!". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls Bolas sending him to the Eye of Ugin to watch, and being left blinded and sleeping.
timeline.quote: Bolas sent me to the Eye. He told me to wait.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye of Ugin and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.
timeline.quote: Every single hedron on the plane glowed as they shifted into new positions.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin agrees to join Sorin at the Eye of Ugin, and Sorin planeswalks away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will join you at the Eye soon.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin deduces from the hedron shard that it came from the Eye after his defeat, and asks who Sarkhan is.
timeline.quote: I'm applying logic.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan explains his history: Ugin's spirit whispered to him, Bolas sent him to the Eye, and he later traveled back in time to save Ugin.
timeline.quote: When I stepped through I traveled back, before the dragons died, and tipped the scales of history.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Thousands of years later, Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace meet in the Eye of Ugin chamber, unintentionally loosening the bonds on the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: unintentionally loosened the bonds that kept the Eldrazi in torpor.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori En go to the Eye, where Ugin is rebuilding the network; Jace sees the hedrons could be used to kill the Eldrazi and leaves despite Ugin's warnings.
timeline.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas manipulates Chandra and sends Sarkhan to the Eye of Ugin to release the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Bolas sent Sarkhan to the Eye and manipulated the pyromancer Chandra Nalaar into arriving at the same time.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace descends into the ruined Eye of Ugin and sees a glow ahead and the stones growing orderly.
timeline.quote: the stones around him became more orderly

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: A dragon unfolds from the shadows; Jace fears it is Bolas, but it introduces itself as Ugin, builder of the Eye.
timeline.quote: My name is Ugin. I helped build this place, long ago.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he knows Jace was one of three planeswalkers who opened the Eye, manipulated by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: You, a pyromancer, and a dragonspeaker. Planeswalkers all. You opened the Eye.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Ugin that Ulamog is headed for Sea Gate, and Ugin shows he does not know the city, having been away for ages.
timeline.quote: I was detained. Sea Gate?

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning the Eldrazi again with the help of his allies.
timeline.quote: You cannot kill Ulamog,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace and Ugin argue over whether the hedrons can be relied on again, and Ugin insists the earlier release was orchestrated.
timeline.quote: It was not an accident,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin conjures an illusion of the hedron network as it was, how it drifted without the Lithomancer, and how it stands now, shattered.
timeline.quote: The hedron network as it stands,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace counters Ugin's illusion with scenes of Sea Gate and of Zendikar's suffering people, insisting Zendikar is somebody's home.
timeline.quote: Zendikar isn't a puzzle to be solved,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace understands a circular glyph with three points that the leylines could be coaxed into forming.
timeline.quote: A glyph—circular, with three points at equal intervals around the circumference.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin says he is here to save the Multiverse, not the people of Zendikar.
timeline.quote: With the Eldrazi at large, the entire Multiverse is at risk.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
timeline.quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi titans dwell in the Blind Eternities and what Jace sees is a projection, so killing them would only free them.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans do not dwell in physical space,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace privately realizes the hedrons might pull the Eldrazi fully into the physical realm so they could be killed, and keeps the idea to himself.
timeline.quote: You could pull him into the pond.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi brood are connected to the titans like cells or organs, so killing them achieves nothing.
timeline.quote: More like cells,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin orders Jace to dissuade his friends from attacking Ulamog and to stop them if necessary, so Ulamog is not driven from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You must dissuade your friends from attacking Ulamog directly

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace agrees but privately resolves to proceed his own way, and leaves the Eye with a plan.
timeline.quote: He had a plan. He had a destination. He was ready.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge.
timeline.quote: she broke the last bonds holding them in, and the titans emerged into the world.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace, guided by Jori En, meets Ugin at the Eye, learns how hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi and decides to ignore Ugin's warnings.
timeline.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye and made his way to Sea Gate

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds the Eye of Ugin collapsed and the three Eldrazi titans escaped.
timeline.quote: But the Eye was a ruin, collapsed in on itself.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra follows the map to the Eye of Ugin, where Sarkhan Vol attacks her as a dragon.
timeline.quote: Vol transformed himself into a dragon and attacked Chandra

citation.text: "Dragon Scroll", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace and Chandra use Ugin's fire to defeat Sarkhan, triggering the last lock of the Eldrazi confinement spell.
timeline.quote: they unwittingly triggered the last lock of the Eldrazi confinement spell

citation.text: "Dragon Scroll", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers fight the Eldrazi, then combine magic at the Eye of Ugin to activate the hedrons, imprisoning the Titans.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The three lock the chamber with a spell only three planeswalkers together could break.
timeline.quote: a spell only three planeswalkers together could break

citation.text: "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin bound the Eldrazi titans within the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: had been lured to Zendikar and bound within the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Release of the Eldrazi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra, followed by Jace and Sarkhan, fought in the Eye and her ghostfire destabilized its enchantments.
timeline.quote: Chandra unleashed a powerful spell using the scroll's contents

citation.text: "Release of the Eldrazi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa interrupted Sorin's ritual and broke the keylock hedron needed to reseal the prison.
timeline.quote: Nissa interrupted Sorin's ritual, and instead broke apart the keylock hedron

citation.text: "Release of the Eldrazi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Ugin says he helped build it.
relations.quote: I helped build this place, long ago.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

pages_say.description: Legendary location on Zendikar whose magic holds the Eldrazi; unlocked by Chandra's fire.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

pages_say.description: A cavern from which Sarkhan took a hedron shard, where he heard Ugin's voice.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

pages_say.description: The tampered place on Zendikar where the Eldrazi's hedron prison was compromised, and where Ugin will join Sorin.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

pages_say.description: The Zendikar chamber from which Sarkhan took a hedron shard.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

pages_say.description: The cavern at the center of the hedron network, built by Ugin, where the Eldrazi were imprisoned.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

pages_say.description: The center of the hedron network that Jace visited.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

pages_say.description: The underground chamber at the center of the hedron network whose magic held the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

pages_say.description: The center of the hedron network where Ugin spoke to Jace.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

pages_say.description: The place on Zendikar from which Nahiri sent a signal that never reached Sorin.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

pages_say.description: The chamber in Akoum at the heart of the hedron array that contained the Eldrazi, now collapsed.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

pages_say.description: A location linked to the secret past of the vampires that Anowon seeks.

pages_say.description: A chamber where Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace met.
